title: Preparation of Spike-in Aliquots of Murine Hepatitis Virus (MHV)
author: Melissa Pitton
materials: Aliquot 510 µL into each prepared Eppendorf tube.
Extract the MHV spike-in aliquot in triplicate using the QiaAmp Viral RNA Minikit (Qiagen) according to manufacturer's instructions.
For each sample, place a QIAamp Mini spin column (Qiagen) in a 2 mL collection tube.
Carefully pipet 630 µL of the sample to the QIAamp Mini spin column (Qiagen).
Extract the MHV spike-in aliquot in triplicate using the QiaAmp Viral RNA Minikit (Qiagen) according to manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the sterile environment and heating equipment.

substeps.instruction: Clean the sterile bench with 70% Ethanol or another appropriate disinfectant.
Turn on the heat block and set it to 65°C.
Switch on the UV light for 20 minutes, if available, to disinfect surfaces.
Prepare 1.5 mL tubes for the required number of aliquots.

steps.title: Prepare MHV Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Thaw and dilute the cultivated Murine Hepatitis Virus (MHV) stock.

substeps.instruction: Heat four 50 µL aliquots of cultivated MHV on the 65°C heat block until thawed.
Prepare 100 mL of 1x PBS solution by adding 10 mL of 10x PBS to 90 mL of nuclease-free water in a 250 mL Corning bottle.
Dilute the cultivated MHV stock 1:500 by adding the 200 µL cultivated MHV to the 100 mL 1x PBS solution.
Invert the 250 mL Corning bottle several times and vortex intermittently for approximately 10-20 seconds (do not vortex too long to avoid affecting the virus).

steps.title: Store Spike-in Aliquots
steps.instruction: Distribute and freeze the prepared MHV solution.

substeps.instruction: Place the aliquots in boxes and store at -80°C.

steps.title: Thaw Spike-in Aliquot
steps.instruction: Thaw a stored MHV spike-in aliquot using the heat block.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve an MHV spike-in aliquot from -80°C and thaw on the heat block at 65°C.
Remove the aliquot when only a small piece of ice remains to prevent overheating. Do not thaw with hands or at room temperature.

steps.title: Initial Sample Mixing
steps.instruction: Combine the virus with buffer and carrier RNA.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 560 µL AVL buffer, 5.6 µL carrier RNA, and 140 µL MHV spike-in together into a 2 mL tube.
Vortex the tubes.
Incubate at room temperature (15 - 25°C) for 10 min.
Spin the tube quickly on a table top centrifuge to remove drops from the inside of the lid.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add ethanol and centrifuge to precipitate nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Add 560 µL ethanol (96%-100%) to each sample and mix by vortexing.
Spin the tube quickly on a table top centrifuge to remove drops from the inside of the lid.
Centrifuge at 6,000 x g (8,000 rpm) for 1 min.
Keep the spin column and discard the collection tube containing the filtrate.
Place the spin column into a new collection tube.
Repeat the ethanol addition and centrifugation steps (steps 20-22 in original text).

steps.title: Wash Spin Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column using AW1 and AW2 buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL buffer AW1 (Qiagen) and centrifuge at 6,000 x g (8,000 rpm) for 1 min.
Discard the collection tube and place the spin column into a new collection tube.
Add 500 µL buffer AW2 (Qiagen) and centrifuge at 20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) or maximum speed for 3 min.
Discard the collection tube and place the spin column into a new collection tube.
Centrifuge again at 20,000 x g (14,000 rpm) or maximum speed for 1 min.

steps.title: Elute Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Elute the MHV RNA from the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column into a clean, labelled 1.5 mL plastic tube.
Add 40 µL of AVE (Qiagen) into the middle of the column.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 6,000 x g (8,000 rpm) for 1 min.
Repeat the elution process to reach a total extract volume of 80 µL.

steps.title: Quantify and Calculate Spike-in Volume
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the extract and calculate the required spike-in volume.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the final extract 10x, 100x, and 1000x.
Quantify MHV in the dilutions in duplicate using an appropriate assay (e.g., Six-plex Digital PCR targeting SARS-CoV-2, MHV, IAV, IBV, and RSV).

Estimate the appropriate volume of MHV to add to each sample (targeting at least 400,000 genome copy equivalents) using the formula: (400,000 genome copy equivalents / (digital PCR output in gc/μL * template volume (5 μL) * eluate volume (80μL) / extracted volume of MHV (140μL))).
Calculate the final amount of virus to spike-in: (rounded volume * (digital PCR output in gc/μL * template volume (5 μL) * eluate volume (80μL) / extracted volume of MHV (140μL))).
